name: Pinball Arcade: Fish Tales
storyline: Fish Tales (1992) is another great game by Mark Ritchie, Designer of other Williams classics such as Taxi. Featuring a fishing theme, this table has many fun modes and features including a high scoring Multi-Ball mode and the challenge of catching Monster Fish! Unique features include a rotating Fishing Reel used to lock balls for Multi-Ball, a boat on the playfield with two ramps, a fishing rod shaped plunger control and an animated fish on the back box topper. The flippers on this table are one eighth of an inch shorter than the standard Williams flippers. 13,640 units of this table were produced.
